name: Cubic Gate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Plane Shift
powers.text: 1 charge: cast Plane Shift to the plane keyed to a side.

powers.name: Gate
powers.text: 1 charge: cast Gate to the plane keyed to a side.

summary: 3 charges: Plane Shift or Gate to one of six planes keyed to its sides.
text: A 3-inch cube humming with magic. Each of its six faces is tied to a different plane: one to the Material Plane, the rest to planes the DM chooses. It has 3 charges and recovers 1d3 each dawn. As a Magic action, spend 1 charge to cast Gate to open a doorway to the plane tied to the face you press, or Plane Shift, sending the targets to that plane. (No one escapes the Mists of Barovia this way.)
